fichas.title: Daylight — Window Lighting
fichas.summary: Explains daylight assessment for window-lit interiors using illuminance and daylight factors. It describes the daylight factor as the ratio of interior to simultaneous exterior illuminance, outlines factors affecting daylight distribution, and gives reference-plane conventions, minimum daylight-factor guidance, and window-width recommendations. The page also illustrates seasonal exterior illuminance, daylight-factor distributions, and the effect of adjacent buildings.
uses: Set reference points for horizontal illuminance
Inform window sizing and visual connections to the outside
